༄༅/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag zung du 'jug pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag zung du 'jug pa bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ don dam dbyings la 'gro 'ong gnas pa bral/ /rnam pa'i tshul las phyogs dus kun du khyab/ /chos rnams kun gyi gdod ma'i gnas lugs mchog /sangs rgyas bla ma chos skur skyabs su mchi/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs sems can sgyu ma 'dra/ /'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam 'di rang sangs nas//ye shes ro mnyam gcig la 'god pa'i phyir/ /bla ma sangs rgyas rjes dran bsgom par bya/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di nyid do/ /zhes dal bus brjod don bsam ste/ de yang*/ rgyal mchog 'dren pa shākya thub pa ste/ /bdud bzhi bcom ldan 'das bcom zhing skal ba drug dang ldan//gnas de bzhin gshegs pa lugs ji bzhin gzigs pa ma nor ba/ /nyon dgra bcom pa mongs bag chags bcas pa ma lus bcom/ /nyes yang dag sangs rgyas skyon kun sangs shes bya thams cad la/ /mkhyen rig pa sogs rab rgyas dus gsum ma lus mkhyen/ /rdzu zhabs ldan 'phrul bgrod pa nam mkha'i mthas gtugs khyab//rgyu bde gshegs mchog bsgrubs pas 'bras bu bla med brnyes/ /las 'jig rten mkhyen nyon sdug bsngal 'khor ba mtha' dag rig /skye 'gro skyes 'dul kha sgyur sems can ma lus thabs kyis 'dul/ /khyod bla med las lhag dang khyod mtshungs gang na'ang med/ /kun lha dang mi'i ston pa la thar lam ston pa'i 'phrin las can/ /zhes pa tshig re re'i don bsam/ de ltar sangs rgyas kun gyi chos kyi sku/ /rtag cing mi 'gyur yon tan kun dang ldan/ /gdon nas nyes pa kun las grol grol ba// 'khor 'das kun la rtag tu khyab par bzhugs/ /spros pa'i mtha' rnams kun gyis rtag tu dben/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i chos sku 'di nyid bzhugs/

/me tog gar yod me tog dri yod ltar/ /gzugs sku gnyis kyang bdag dang 'bral ba med/ /ces brjod cing don bsam/ 'di ltar nas gzung de nyid lan mang du bsam mo/ /rang gi mdun nam spyi bo'am snying gar mtshan dpe thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs par gyur/ 'di nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa yin/ /dpal ldan bla ma sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /chos sku nyag gcig nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /chos kun rang bzhin gdod ma'i ye shes 'di/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs mchog chos kyi sku/ /sangs rgyas kun dang ro mnyam gnyis su med//bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam rtog 'bad rtsol spros pa mi mnga' yang*/ /gang 'dul sku yi snangab mtha' yas ston/ /gzugs sku bshes gnyen dam pa'i rnam par shar/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang khyod la gsol ba 'debs//rgyal ba rigs lnga gdod nas lhun grub ste/ /gzhan snang phung lnga'i tshul gyis 'gro don mdzad/ /phung po'i rnam pas 'dul ba'i sgrol kun sgrol/ /phung po gzhan mchog khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos nyid gdod ma'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ /sems dpa' yab yum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma/ /'byung bzhi dbang po sogs kyis 'dul ba la/ /de de'i rnam par ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun gyi rang bzhin ye shes spros bral las/ /chos sku mkha' khyab zhes bya gzhan yod min/ /de nyid drin can chos rje khyod kyi thugs/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /don dam srid gsum gdod nas rang shar te/ /gdul bya'i snang ngor srid gsum kun tu snang*/ /don med ma yin rtag tu phan bder mdzad/ /'phrin las lhun grub khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi rang bzhin bla ma khyed/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas kun dngos lags/ /'gro ba kun gyi snying por bzhugs pa ste/

/bdag gis mngon sum rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa sangs rgyas rjes dran dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag zung du 'dug pa'o/ /spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan dran pas dang ba yang yang bsgom pa la/ sangs rgyas rjes dran zhes zer ba yin/ chos ni sangs rgyas des gsungs pa 'jug ldog spang blang gi don yin/ gsung de bzhin du ma 'khrul bar byed mkhan dge 'dun yin/ chos dge ba'i 'jug sgo sbyin pa dang tshul khrims yin pas de ltar shes nas yid ches dad pa sgom pa dang*/ rang re'i spyod pa bag yod byed dgos pa'i dpang po dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams yin te/ de ltar na rjes dran phyi ma rnams sangs rgyas rjes dran du 'dus shing*/ de'i zhor las byung ba yin pas 'di sgoms na de dag mtha' dag bsgoms par 'gyur la skyon kun spangs yon tan kun rdzogs gzhan gang dang yang mnyam pa med par shes nas dad pa ni/ theg pa che chung thams cad kyi spyi 'gro yin/ gzugs kyi sku dang yang 'brel ba rtogs pa ye shes chos sku'i nang tshan lam bden gyis bsdus pa'i rnam mkhyen ni/ rgyu phun sum tshogs pa mtha' yas pa'i bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu skyon kun spangs yon tan kun rdzogs kyi ye shes 'dus byas su gtogs pa de yin la/ de lta bu de yang gang la brten pa'i gzhi/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes chos sku kun khyab nyes skyon gang gis kyang gdod ma nas gos ma myong zhing*/ don dam pa'i yon tan srid tshad gdod nas rang grub pa de ni don dam pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku shes bya thams cad la khyab pa'i gnas lugs yin la/ gzugs sku gnyis dang lam bden chos sku yang chos nyid don dam de ka'i mdangs 'od tsam yin par shes nas/ nye ring med pa'i skyabs gnas de la dad pas rjes su dran par byed pa ni/ theg dman pa'i grub mtha' smra ba dang thun mong ma yin pa/

theg pa chen po spyi'i lugs yin/ theg pa bla na med pa'i gsang sngags su/ chos dbyings sku gsung ro gcig mnyam pa nyid de yang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bde stong lhan cig skyes pa zung du 'jug par shes pa dgos te/ de ni thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos lhag por snon rgyu yin/ de nyid bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang sbrel na/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin ni don dam sangs rgyas chos dbyings de kho na dang*/ rnam 'gyur dang mdzad pa thams cad kyang*/ de ka'i rnam 'gyur gdul bya gzhan snang du shar ba'i gzugs sku 'phrin las dang bcas par nges shes bskyed nas gsol ba 'debs pa de ka lags/ gsang sngags pa'i rtsa ba bla ma rdo rje slob dpon ni sangs rgyas kun 'dus yin pas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor de sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi mchog yin/ rang rgyud la gnas lugs rtogs tshul bzang ngan gyi dbye bas/ bla ma sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa de la'ang mtho dman gyi dbye ba mang du 'byung mod/ dmigs pa bsgom tshul la khyad par med do zhes go bar bya'o//zhes pa 'di yang bzang ldan pa yi ge mkhan po dad ldan dge slong kun dga' bde legs kyis bskul nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang nyid rgyun gyi nyams len byed pa'i don dang mthun par bkod pa ste/ rang re'i rjes su slob par 'dod pa rnams kyis kyang nyin re dus gsum du nan tan gyis bsgom par 'os so// //zhu dag maṅga laṃ//dpal rtag brtan gyi chos sde chen por/ 7 rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha'i zhal snga nas/ rgyal ba'i bka' nges don mdo nyi shu po 'di/ par du bsgrub pa la do gal ches cher gnang ba'i dgos pa/ gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lung 'dren rgyab rten tsam du dgongs sam zhe na/ gdul byar gyur pa rnams ni/ gtso bor bla ma'i bka' la yid ches shing nges pa rnyed par 'gyur ba'i lung gi tshogs kho nar ma bltos pa dang*/

snod du ma byon pa rnams la lung dngos gsal ji tsam spungs kyang rang rang gi bag chags kyi rjes su 'brang bas/ de dag la lung gi 'jug sgo yang ma byung ba'i phyir/ dgag sgrub kyi ched kho nar par gyi do gal mi mdzad pa 'dug lags/ 'o na ci zhe na/ don gyi gtso bo mdo don thams cad kyi yang snying zab mo 'di dag par du btab nas glegs bam du bkod de/ rnam pa thams cad du phyag mchod ci 'grub dang*/ nyin rer klog thun 'tsham pa'am/ dus dus su klog 'don ji ltar 'os pa dang*/ rgyun du de dag gi snying po sangs rgyas rjes dran dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor zung du 'jug pa'i man ngag 'di bsgom zhing*/ nges don gyi smon lam khyad par can rnams kyis mtshams sbyar na/ dus nam zhig gi tshe gtan gyi 'dun ma yang dag pa lhun grub tu 'byung ba la dgongs pa/ de'i phyir par gyi gras tshad kyang dpe cha dang mthun pa kho na gong bzhin 'grub sla ba yong ba'i phebs sgo yod lags// //zhes yi ge pa kun dga' bde legs kyi rgyus kyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/sangs rgyas rjes dran dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag 'jug pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 292 --PAGE 293--PAGE 291-
